info.name: Konekta API — QA Regression Suite
info.description: Automated regression suite for the Konekta backend (Express + TypeScript + MySQL). Built from Konekta_QA_Test_Case_Matrix.xlsx and Konekta_QA_Bug_Report.md. BUG-001 through BUG-004 have been fixed and this suite verifies the fixes; BUG-005 (subscriptions endpoint naming overlap) remains an open observation pending a product decision.

exec: pm.test('Returns token and user', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.user.role).to.eql('influencer'); });
pm.test('Generic message, no user enumeration', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Same generic message as wrong-password case', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Same generic message regardless of existence', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('If the email exists'));

item.name: Reset Password - Token below min length (boundary)
Mass-assignment attempt - foreign id in body (should be ignored)

exec: pm.test('Update still scopes to caller, not injected id', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('influencer1_id'))));

item.name: Influencer calls brand-only update (negative, role gate)
role=brand query WITHOUT auth (no data leak)

exec: pm.test('No data leaked to anonymous caller', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty);

item.name: Brand views influencer's submissions for the offer

exec: pm.test('Includes influencer profile and reward', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.influencer).to.exist; pm.expect(d.reward).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: Brand pays influencer for the offer [end-to-end payment check]

exec: // A second payment for the same offer/influencer pair correctly conflicts (409) —
// this endpoint is idempotent-safe. Accept either a fresh 200 or a 409 on repeat runs.
pm.test('Either pays successfully or correctly blocks a duplicate payment', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 409]));

exec: // Uses /health instead of /auth/login on purpose, so this check
// is not affected by the /auth/* rate limiter shared with other tests.

item.name: Rate limit probe (run this folder alone, 21+ times, expect 429 near the end)

request.description: Run this single request 25 times in a row (Postman Runner, iteration count 25) in ISOLATION from the rest of the suite. The /auth/* limiter is a shared in-memory counter per IP (max 20 requests / 15 min), so mixing this with other auth tests in the same run will cause unrelated tests to fail with 429.

exec: pm.test('Either rejected auth or rate limited', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 429]));
